stage_name: D3.5-A5-R1-R1 — Relevance Formula & Exact-Match Contract Repair
stage_type: narrow design-contract repair only; no repaired-scorer implementation, no real-case runs, no runtime/D1/database changes

preserved_unchanged: MIN_PRIMARY_SCORE >= 1 remains the unchanged hard gate
no file-type bonuses, no case-specific rules, no LLM/embedding scorer

idf_defect.defect: df(t) = |U| gives idf = log2(|U| / (|U| + 1)) < 0: a matched query token that is ubiquitous in the eligible universe would create negative relevance evidence
idf_defect.severity: design-contract defect; must be repaired before R2 implements the formula

repaired_idf_formula.properties: non-negative on 1 <= df <= N; idf(df = N) = 0; strictly decreasing in df; deterministic for identical (N, df); no corpus-global statistics; no expected evidence; no case-specific constants
repaired_idf_formula.numeric_behavior: floating-point values are allowed only for ranking; ranking compares the unrounded deterministic computed values; serialization may round values for diagnostics only
repaired_idf_formula.selected_over_alternatives: the task-preferred formula is adopted unchanged: it satisfies every required invariant with the smallest deviation from the R1 contract; no alternative formula is needed

idf_invariants: for N = |U| >= 1 and 1 <= df <= N: idf(df) >= 0
same N + same df => deterministic same value
no corpus-global statistics, no expected evidence, no case-specific constants

df_definition.definition: number of UNIQUE eligible candidate object IDs whose candidate_lexical_view contains token t
df_definition.multi_origin_rule: a candidate belonging to multiple provenance origins counts exactly once

candidate_lexical_view.definition: deduplicated union of tokens from locator basename, locator parent-directory components, title, and bounded text[:2000]
candidate_lexical_view.tokenization: the frozen v1 lexical tokenizer (NFKD -> camelCase split -> casefold -> non-alphanumeric separators -> dedupe)
candidate_lexical_view.set_semantics: all tokens are sets for df purposes; repeated occurrences inside one candidate do not increase df
candidate_lexical_view.effect: removes the R1-diagnosed path/title duplicate contribution: a token present in path + title + text contributes its IDF weight exactly once at ranking level 2

symbol_exact_normalization.plan_symbol_side: Unicode NFKC -> casefold -> path separators normalized to '/'
symbol_exact_normalization.candidate_surface_side: identical normalization (Unicode NFKC -> casefold -> path separators to '/')
symbol_exact_normalization.compound_identifier_preserved: the compound identifier is NEVER split for the symbol_exact_tier (restgas_profile remains one identifier); the ordinary lexical tokenizer may still split it for the separate split-token signals

symbol_exact_boundary_contract.rule: a normalized compound symbol matches only if its normalized occurrence is bounded on both sides by start/end of string OR a character that is NOT in [a-z0-9_]
symbol_exact_boundary_contract.identifier_character_class: [a-z0-9_] — underscore is part of an identifier and never a boundary

symbol_exact_semantics_decisions.hyphen: restgas-profile does NOT count as an exact compound-symbol match for restgas_profile (no invented equivalence; it may still receive ordinary split-token lexical overlap)
symbol_exact_semantics_decisions.camelcase: RestgasProfile does NOT automatically equal restgas_profile for this tier (no camel-splitting of the candidate surface before exact matching; no existing canonical identifier normalization establishes equivalence)
symbol_exact_semantics_decisions.title_in_symbol_tier: EXCLUDED by the strong default: the persisted title is synthetic/descriptive and duplicates path semantics for source-file objects; recorded explicitly as a frozen decision
symbol_exact_semantics_decisions.empty_plan_symbols: if plan.symbols = [] then symbol_exact_tier = 0 for every candidate; no fallback to inferred symbols
symbol_exact_semantics_decisions.ranking_only: symbol_exact_tier remains PRIMARY_RANK level 1; it is not governance authority, hard inclusion rule, answer truth, or required-evidence mapping; a candidate without an exact symbol may still win through later generic relevance levels

symbol_exact_count_semantics.definition: number of DISTINCT plan symbols that have at least one valid boundary-aware exact match in any allowed candidate surface
symbol_exact_count_semantics.occurrence_rule: a symbol occurring 10 times contributes 1, not 10
symbol_exact_count_semantics.multi_surface_rule: the same symbol matching path and text still contributes once

v2_exact_rank_order: 4. text_presence DESC (distinct normal query tokens in tokenized text[:2000]; not raw occurrence count; the compound symbol exact count is not re-included here beyond what naturally results from the ordinary split-token representation)
5. support_rank ASC (missing support sorts worse than any present support but never disqualifies)

lexical_view_dedup_semantics.rule: basename, parent-directory, title, and text tokens are combined as one deduplicated token set before the IDF-weighted overlap (level 2); a token present in path + title + text contributes its IDF weight once
lexical_view_dedup_semantics.basename_coverage_independence: basename_coverage deliberately remains a separate later lexicographic level: cross-level structural specificity is intentional, not double-counting within one score
lexical_view_dedup_semantics.text_presence_independence: text_presence counts distinct normal query tokens only and is a separate later lexicographic level for the same reason

GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION.definition: a required-evidence candidate is present in the complete pre-cap eligible governed universe AND the repaired evaluator identifies it as required evidence BUT the unchanged MIN_PRIMARY_SCORE >= 1 path/title gate rejects it before v2 ranking is applied
GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION.distinct_from: APPLICABLE_AND_LOST_AFTER_RANKING (passes the gate but lost by ranking/caps)
GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION.response_rule: if R2 observes GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION, do NOT modify the gate inside R2 after outcome exposure; record it and stop/route to a later design stage; R1-R1 does not change the gate

future_evaluator_classes.NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_SELECTIVITY: required evidence absent from the complete eligible governed universe
future_evaluator_classes.GATE_RECALL_LIMITATION: present in the eligible universe but rejected by the unchanged hard relevance gate
future_evaluator_classes.APPLICABLE_AND_RETAINED: passes the gate and retained by repaired selectivity
future_evaluator_classes.APPLICABLE_AND_LOST: passes the gate but lost by repaired ranking/caps

complete_universe_evaluator_contract_pre.contract: complete pre-cap eligible governed universe x frozen evaluator-only expected-evidence selectors

sequence: R2 implementation of exactly the frozen v2 contract
evaluator implementation (complete-universe matching with the four applicability classes)
r2_anti_tuning_contract.r2_ambiguity_rule: if R2 discovers ambiguity: STOP BEFORE REAL-CASE OUTCOME; do not improvise

property_checks_executed.scope: mathematical/property-level checks of the repaired IDF formula and the boundary matcher on synthetic strings only; no real-case candidate outcomes
property_checks_executed.source: data/tmp/r1r1_property_checks.json (gitignored working record; results embedded here)

decision_basis: both defects are fully frozen: (1) the repaired IDF formula satisfies every required invariant (verified 17/17 synthetic property checks including the negative-defect reproduction); (2) the symbol-exact contract is now implementation-unambiguous (normalization, boundaries, surfaces, count semantics, empty-symbols behavior). R2 has no discretion over any contract detail.
exact_next_stage: D3.5-A5-R2 — Repaired Selectivity Prototype Freeze & Revalidation (READY_TO_IMPLEMENT)
prohibited_actions: implement the v2 scorer inside R1-R1
try alternative IDF formulas on real cases
